Hunter Orc Warrior.reason: REVIEW: the vanilla Hunter Orc Warrior has no race, faction, unit type or base size; its sibling Hunter Orc Warg Rider has race Orc, faction Gundabad, types Warrior + Cavalry, 25mm. The Warrior is the same Orc on foot, so Infantry replaces Cavalry.
Hunter Orc Warrior.source: vanilla Hunter Orc Warg Rider (sibling profile)

Vault Warden Team.reason: REVIEW: the vanilla Vault Warden Team is a bundle (it includes Iron Shield Bearer and Foe Spear Wielder) with no race, faction or unit type; both members are Dwarf, Khazad-dum, Warrior + Infantry, so the bundle takes those keywords.
Vault Warden Team.source: vanilla Iron Shield Bearer and Foe Spear Wielder (included profiles)

Brego.reason: REVIEW: Brego has no keywords in vanilla; he is a horse like Shadowfax (Horse, Mount, faction of the rider: Theodred of Rohan or Aragorn).

War boar.reason: REVIEW: the War boar (Dain Ironfoot's mount) has no keywords in vanilla; its race is the animal, the faction is the rider's, as for the War goat.

Elk.reason: REVIEW: Thranduil's Elk has no keywords in vanilla; the Great Elk is Elk, Mirkwood, Mount, but the faction is read as the rider's.

Cart.reason: REVIEW: Gandalf's Cart has no keywords in vanilla; the sibling Gandalf's Cart is Horse, Mount.

Moria Goblin Drum (Drum).reason: REVIEW: the drum has no race, faction or type in vanilla (its keyword list is a copy of the White Warg's); it is a gear item of type mount, so only the Mount type is given.
